faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about Our Hispanic Clinic
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our medical services in Houston
faq.q1: Do I need an appointment to be seen at the FM 529 clinic?
faq.a1: No. Walk in at 15003 FM 529, Suite B, any day from 9 in the morning: we keep seeing patients until 9 at night Monday to Saturday and until 5 in the afternoon on Sunday. If you would rather give us a heads-up first, call or WhatsApp (281) 694-7250.
faq.q2: I don't have health insurance. Can I still be seen at 529?
faq.a2: Yes. Clínica Hispana Familiar 529 does not ask for insurance: you pay directly at the visit. You can ask the price of a service by phone or WhatsApp, and current deals are on the promotions page.
faq.a3: Spanish and English, from the front desk to the exam room. That way you can describe your symptoms in your own words and fully understand your treatment, and family members who prefer English are cared for in their language too.
faq.q4: What are your weekday and Sunday hours?
faq.a4: Monday through Saturday we are open 9 AM to 9 PM, so you can come after work or school. On Sunday hours are 9 AM to 5 PM. On holidays, call ahead to confirm.
faq.q5: How can I pay for my visit?
faq.a5: Cash, card or mobile phone payments. It is self-pay with no insurance paperwork, and you can find out the cost before you come by calling or sending the clinic a WhatsApp message.
faq.q6: How long has the clinic been open?
faq.a6: Clínica Hispana Familiar 529 opened in November 2023 on FM 529 in northwest Houston, so families in Copperfield, Bear Creek and Cypress could get medical care in Spanish close to home.
faq.a7: At 15003 FM 529, Suite B, Houston, TX 77095, in northwest Houston near Highway 6. It is convenient for Copperfield, Bear Creek, Cypress, Jersey Village, Katy, Langham Creek and Addicks.
faq.q8: Who performs the I-693 exam at the FM 529 clinic?
faq.a8: Yes. It is performed by a USCIS-authorized Civil Surgeon: physical exam, TB blood test, age-based lab work and any vaccines you are missing. The form is handed over in a sealed envelope, ready for your residency application.
faq.q9: Which services are available at the clinic?
faq.a9: General visits, diabetes and blood pressure management, rapid flu, COVID, strep and pregnancy tests, lab work, EKG, ultrasound, vaccines, DOT and school physicals, procedures such as stitches or abscess drainage, and the medications prescribed during your visit.
faq.a10: Yes, the clinic has free patient parking at 15003 FM 529. If you are coming along Highway 6, the clinic is close to where it crosses FM 529, in northwest Houston.
faq.q11: Is there a Hispanic clinic near Copperfield or Cypress?
faq.a11: Yes. Clínica Hispana Familiar 529 is in ZIP 77095 and sees patients from the neighboring 77084, 77433 and 77449 ZIP codes. It is a family clinic with care in Spanish, walk-ins welcome and no insurance required.
faq.q12: Can my whole family get care here?
faq.a12: Yes. You can handle general medicine visits, diabetes, blood pressure or cholesterol management, the kids' school physicals and lab work here, all in one place with the clinic's medical team.

about.title: What is Clínica Hispana Familiar 529?
about.paragraph: Clínica Hispana Familiar 529 is a walk-in primary care clinic at 15003 FM 529, Suite B, Houston, TX 77095, in northwest Houston, near Highway 6 and the Copperfield, Cypress and Bear Creek areas. It opened in November 2023. It sees patients 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday to Saturday and closes at 5:00 PM on Sunday. No health insurance is required: patients pay directly with cash, card or phone. Visits are in Spanish and also in English. The medical team provides family medicine and <chronic>diabetes, blood pressure and cholesterol management</chronic>, <gyn>gynecology with Pap smears</gyn>, <men>men's health with prostate screening</men>, <lab>blood tests</lab>, ultrasound, EKG, vaccines, <uti>urinary tract infection care</uti>, STD testing, wound care and minor surgery, school physicals and <dot>DOT physicals for the CDL</dot>, and the <imm>I-693 immigration medical exam</imm> with a USCIS-designated Civil Surgeon. Phone and WhatsApp: (281) 694-7250.

faq.q1: How long are the promotions available?
faq.a1: Our promotions are for a limited time and prices may change. We recommend calling or writing to us to confirm availability and schedule your appointment.
faq.q2: Do I need an appointment or medical insurance?
faq.a2: You do not need medical insurance. We welcome walk-ins and you can also schedule in advance. We offer affordable self-pay prices.
faq.q3: How do I book a promotion?
faq.a3: You can call us, use the Get directions button to visit us, or fill out the contact form and our team will reach out to coordinate your appointment.
